meta.ogDescription: CNFS events calendar - competitions, milestones, and upcoming activities.

props.label: Competitions
props.title: Race Calendar 2027
props.intro: Our target competitions for the 2025/2026 season.

events.title: Formula Student France (Transpolis)
events.text: Our primary target for the inaugural season. Teams from across Europe compete in static and dynamic events over 4 days. This is where CNFS makes its debut.

events.title: Formula Student Germany
events.text: The largest and most prestigious Formula Student event in the world. Over 100 teams compete at the legendary Hockenheimring. A goal for our second or third season.

events.title: Formula Student UK
events.text: One of the oldest and most respected FS events, held at the home of British motorsport. An aspirational target as we grow.

props.label: Season 2025/2026
props.title: Team Milestones
props.intro: Key dates in our journey from concept to competition.

events.title: Season Kickoff & Recruitment
events.text: Official launch of the 2025/2026 season. Open recruitment across all departments — mechanical, electrical, software, business, and marketing.

events.title: Concept Design Review
events.text: All departments present their initial concepts. The team selects the final design direction for chassis, powertrain, suspension, and aerodynamics.

events.title: Critical Design Review
events.text: Final design freeze. All CAD models, FEA simulations, and manufacturing plans are reviewed and approved. Production-ready drawings are released.

events.title: Manufacturing Begins
events.text: Chassis welding, component machining, composite layup, and electronics assembly begin in Centrale Nantes workshops.

events.title: Rollout & Shakedown
events.text: The car hits the ground for the first time. Systems integration, first fire-up, and initial shakedown testing. A landmark moment for the team.

events.title: Testing & Driver Training
events.text: Intensive testing programme: suspension tuning, engine mapping, brake balance, and driver training sessions ahead of competition.

props.label: Community
props.title: Partner & Public Events
props.intro: Opportunities to meet the team, see the car, and connect with CNFS.

cards.title: Car Reveal Day
cards.text: A public unveiling of the finished car for sponsors, university staff, and media. Includes technical presentations and networking.

cards.title: Open Workshop Days
cards.text: Monthly open-door sessions where sponsors and prospective members can visit the workshop, meet the team, and see progress first-hand.

cards.title: End-of-Season Gala
cards.text: Annual celebration for the team and partners. Presentation of results, recognition of sponsors, and planning for the next season.

props.title: Want to Attend an Event?
props.text: Contact us for invitations to car reveal, open workshops, and competition VIP access.
